title: Baba Vanga's April 1995 prediction of the chess federation presidency

tellings.quote: Then in the spring of 1995, in April of 95, Baba Vanga and her niece call me saying, "Kerson, come here."

plain: In April 1995 Baba Vanga, a Bulgarian fortune-teller, and her niece called a Russian regional leader, saying "Kerson, come here," and told him about his future presidency of the world chess federation. The man himself, a former president of a republic within Russia, tells Jesse Michels this as something that happened to him, and mentions the Guinness book of records in the telling. If true, the seer foresaw his rise before it happened.
